text:
1. 2. 3. 

Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thīnamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannaṃ vā thīnamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave arati tandi vijambhikā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ. Līnacittassa bhikkhave anuppannaṃ ceva thīnamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca thīnamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya veppulāya saṃvattatīti.
